title: Missing Hash derive on EmailAddress, AddressGroup, HeaderDateTime
description: header_typed.rs:40, 55, 67 — derive list is `Debug, Clone, [Copy,] PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize` but not `Hash`. RFC 5322 mailboxes (EmailAddress) are routinely used in deduplication sets (e.g. uniqueing a recipient list across To/Cc/Bcc), HeaderDateTime values key time-series buckets, and AddressGroup values appear in 'group by group name' aggregations. All three types are composed entirely of `Hash`-able fields (`Option<String>`, `Vec<EmailAddress>` once EmailAddress has Hash, integer primitives, bool). The missing derives force callers to wrap the type in a newtype just to put it in a `HashSet`, which is the friction the derive system exists to remove. Prerequisite for adding `Hash` to HeaderValueTyped.
close_reason: Type-definition cleanup batch on the typed header surface: (.4) added #[non_exhaustive] to EmailAddress and AddressGroup (HeaderDateTime was already done); (.5) dropped Copy from HeaderDateTime; (.26) dropped Copy from HeaderForm; (.18/.19/.20) added Display impls — RFC 5322 §3.4 mailbox/group form for EmailAddress/AddressGroup, RFC 3339 form for HeaderDateTime; (.34/.35) added Hash on EmailAddress/AddressGroup/HeaderDateTime/HeaderValueTyped; (.36) added Default on EmailAddress/AddressGroup; (.33) symmetric by-value internal signature on to_mail_parser/from_mail_parser. New public constructors EmailAddress::new and AddressGroup::new for callers blocked by #[non_exhaustive]. New tests cover Display, Hash, and TzSign.
